instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot. In an indoor martial arts studio with wooden walls and dark floor mats, the man in the white gi (R1) on the left and the man in the gray gi (R2) on the right face each other in a bent-over grappling stance. The man in the gray gi (R2) grips the back of R1's neck, while R1 reaches his hand downward. Warm, natural indoor lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the floor.
elements: R2 grips the back of R1's neck rather than R1 gripping the back of R2's neck
R1 reaches his hand downward while R2 maintains the neck grip
R1 and R2 face each other in a bent-over grappling stance

indoor martial arts studio with wooden walls
